gloss: to look through, to skim, to glance over

definitions.gloss: to look through, to skim, to glance over
definitions.explanation: To read or review something quickly to get the general content without reading every detail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{通|とお}して⟦おいて→ておく：30378_teoku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{目|め}を{通|とお}す⟦べきだ→べきだ：26592_bekida⟧。
examples.english: You should always look through contracts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{通|とお}す。
examples.english: I skim the newspaper in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ざっと→ざっと：02833_zatto⟧{目|め}を{通|とお}した。
examples.english: I quickly glanced through the materials.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + {通|とお}す (to pass through). Literally 'to pass one's eyes through' something.

NUANCE: Implies quick review rather than careful, thorough reading. Often used for:
- Documents, reports, contracts
- Newspapers, magazines
- Email, messages

DEGREES OF THOROUGHNESS:
- {目|め}を{通|とお}す: skim, look over (quick)
- ⟦ざっと→ざっと：02833_zatto⟧{目|め}を{通|とお}す: very quick glance
- ⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{目|め}を{通|とお}す: look through carefully

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) - general, neutral
- ⟦{熟読|じゅくどく}する→熟読：17535_jukudoku⟧ (to read thoroughly) - careful reading
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{読|よ}み→斜め読み：22744_nanameyomi⟧ (skimming) - reading diagonally
- ⟦{一読|いちどく}する→一読：17764_ichidoku⟧ (to read once through)

OTHER ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{目|め}が{離|はな}せない→目が離せない：06890_megahanasenai⟧: can't take eyes off
- ⟦{目|め}を{配|くば}る→目を配る：noentry⟧: to keep an eye on
- ⟦{目|め}を{引|ひ}く→目を引く：noentry⟧: to catch one's eye
